dialogues.speaker: Eury
dialogues.text: Hello! Are you looking for anything in particular?

dialogues.speaker: Eury
dialogues.text: I envy those who can show restraint when shopping...

dialogues.speaker: Eury
dialogues.text: Once I see an "on sale" sign, the Mora in my coin pouch goes away like the wind...

dialogues.speaker: Eury
dialogues.text: *sigh* Have you seen my alcoholic scoundrel of a husband by any chance? I hope he's not scurried off to find a drink somewhere...

dialogues.speaker: Eury
dialogues.text: Just now, a beautiful gemstone ring caught my attention.

dialogues.speaker: Eury
dialogues.text: I accidentally picked it up. It was a huge mistake...

dialogues.speaker: Eury
dialogues.text: I should've known. The price tag is something I can't afford...

dialogues.speaker: Eury
dialogues.text: Okay, goodbye! Hope you enjoy Mondstadt!

dialogues.speaker: Eury
dialogues.text: *sigh* I only realized that those days of window-shopping and haggling with shopkeepers was "peace" when I experienced Stormterror's attack.

dialogues.speaker: Eury
dialogues.text: I was originally planning to get my husband to kick his drinking habit...

dialogues.speaker: Eury
dialogues.text: ...But in celebration of this hard-won peace, I suppose I can put it off for now.
